entities.title: State the supported specification versions in pom.xml
entities.summary: VERSIONING.md asks each library to state its specification versions and conformance profiles in its package metadata where the ecosystem allows; pom.xml states neither.
entities.expected: pom.xml carries the supported specification versions (utv/1.0, utv-result/1.0, utv-text/1) and the claimed profiles (none yet), for example in <name> and <description>, as the C# project does in its package description.
entities.observed: pom.xml has groupId, artifactId, version and packaging only; the README is the one place that states them.
acceptanceCriteria: pom.xml names the specification versions read and the conformance profiles claimed, matching the README.

origin.description: Implementation versions: each library MUST state, in its README and in its package metadata where the ecosystem allows, which specification versions and conformance profiles it supports.
